findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "directory" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inite_connect · Private data: business · Public sink: find_business.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: inite_connect · Private data: business · Public sink: find_business

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
